data.label: Common Mistakes
data.title:
5 website mistakes that
*cost you calls*
data.sub: Swipe to see if you're losing leads →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: No *phone number* on top
data.body: If customers have to hunt for your number, they will move to a competitor. Make your contact info instantly visible.
data.fix: Fix: Place your phone number in the top right header.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Site is *hard to read* on mobile
data.body: Most people search for services on their phones. If your site is broken or zoomed out, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Ensure your text is large and buttons are tap-friendly.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: The page *loads too slowly*
data.body: Potential customers are impatient. If your site takes more than a few seconds to load, you are losing money.
data.fix: Fix: Resize your images to be smaller file sizes.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Missing a *clear call-to-action*
data.body: Don't make visitors guess what to do next. Tell them exactly how to book your services right now.
data.fix: Fix: Add a button that says 'Call Now' or 'Book'.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: No *location details* visible
data.body: People need to know if you serve their area. Without your city or service zone, they won't trust you.
data.fix: Fix: Add your city and service area to the footer.
